<a id="zanna-testing-suite"></a>
### `Zanna.Testing.Suite`

Accumulates check results and emits one machine-readable verdict.

Unlike `Zanna.Core.Diagnostics.Assert*`, which traps on the first failure, every member here
records the outcome and returns it, so a test program runs to completion and reports all
failures. `Report` prints the single `RESULT:` line a runner greps; `ExitCode` gives the
matching process status.

Constructor: `Zanna.Testing.Suite.New`

<a id="zanna-testing-golden"></a>
### `Zanna.Testing.Golden`

Compares generated output against a recorded SHA-256 digest.

`Check` always prints the computed digest so a moved golden can be re-pinned by copy-paste, and
treats an empty or `"UNSET"` expected value as baseline mode rather than a failure — a first run
must not read as a pass.
